name: Misr Beni Suef Cement Co. S.A.E

valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.peRouteNote: the two P/E routes differ (market cap over net profit 54.94, price over EPS 74.07); the net-profit row reconciles with the filing's own profit before tax less tax, so the EPS row is the one filed in a different unit
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: the same company (misrbenisuefcementcosae) is served under two keys, EGS3C371C019 PE is withheld on the issuer's own figures (the period FY2022 reports no positive net profit, so a P/E is not defined) while EGS3C371C019.CA PE 53.16; one market capitalisation cannot be two, so neither multiple is verified. Every market-based multiple of this security is built on that market cap, so none of them is a valuation. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pegFormula: P/E divided by the growth rate of earnings, the growth rate expressed in percent
valuation.pegGrowthBasis: net profit compound annual growth of 47.76 percent a year from FY2021 (1.69058e+08) to FY2023 (3.691e+08), over 2 years
valuation.peEpsSource: net profit for FY2023 divided by the shares on file
valuation.pbFormula: current price / book value per share, where book value per share = total equity / shares outstanding
valuation.pbEquityRow: total_equity on the balance sheet for FY2023
valuation.pbSharesSource: the same 5.50223e+07 shares behind the market capitalisation (static_data\market_EGX.json)
valuation.psFormula: current price / revenue per share, where revenue per share = revenue / shares outstanding
valuation.psRevenueRow: the income statement's revenue line for FY2023, read from the row labelled 'Revenue'
valuation.psSharesSource: the same 5.50223e+07 shares behind the market capitalisation (static_data\market_EGX.json)
